title: Gulf MCR
summary: A Middle Eastern cafe concept shaped around brand atmosphere, bilingual cues, responsive sections and purposeful motion.
challenge: Translate a real cafe's identity into a premium web experience without turning it into a generic restaurant template.
solution: Built an atmospheric editorial layout with Arabic-influenced visual cues, mobile navigation, media slots and restrained interaction.
outcome: A deployed demo used as part of the 100-Day Local Business Website Challenge and direct business outreach.

title: Tasteology
summary: An editorial cafe website with branded typography, food storytelling, gallery structure and scroll-driven interactions.
challenge: Create something visually memorable while still keeping menu, location and navigation usable on mobile.
solution: Used bold typography, an ingredient-driven visual system, controlled motion and clear section sequencing.
outcome: A live GitHub Pages build demonstrating brand interpretation, layout refinement and responsive debugging.

title: Artista Perfetto
summary: A SITEPRO-led client-facing cafe demo built around real business media, practical information, signature products and a sharper mobile experience.
challenge: Represent a distinctive specialty coffee business accurately without inventing brand assets, fake menu imagery or disputed public information.
solution: Reduced decorative excess, used real Artista Perfetto media, improved information order, keyboard-accessible tabs, a resilient carousel and mobile-first QA.
outcome: A public GitHub Pages demo that shows a more disciplined human-first version of the SITEPRO workflow.

title: Moor Coffee
summary: A compact editorial cafe experience shaped around Moor Coffee's real media, mobile-first composition and playful cat cues.
challenge: Turn the cafe's visual character into a useful responsive experience without letting decorative ideas overpower the content.
solution: Used real cafe imagery, compact editorial sections, restrained cat details, food and drink storytelling, looping media and a responsive navigation system.
outcome: A completed challenge build deployed publicly as Day 04 of the 100-Day website series.

title: Something More Productive
summary: A community-first cafe website built around events, local character, social content and a deliberate mobile composition.
challenge: Translate an active social-first cafe into a useful website without flattening its community personality or forcing a generic cafe template.
solution: Structured the experience around useful social proof, community moments, events, clear calls to action and responsive content that works as a mobile composition of its own.
outcome: A completed and deployed Day 05 build that extends the challenge beyond visual experiments into clearer content strategy.

title: Always The Same
summary: A daytime specialty-coffee website for Always The Same, focused on clear venue information, food and coffee storytelling, and a polished responsive experience.
challenge: Present a coffee concept operating from an existing venue clearly enough that visitors understand the daytime identity, offering and location without confusion.
solution: Built a focused brand story around specialty coffee, food, venue context and practical visit information, then refined the interface for responsive use.
outcome: A completed and publicly deployed Day 06 build, bringing the first six challenge days into one inspectable progression.
